description: Find active U.S. homes for sale or rent in a city+state, ZIP codes, a radius around a point, or a polygon. Hard requirements (max_price, min_bedrooms, min_bathrooms, property_types, must_have) filter; soft preferences (ideal_max_price, preferred_bedrooms, nice_to_have, styles) rank; avoid and exclude_property_types exclude. Each result has a 0-100 match score with reasons and uncertainties, the features the listing states (with evidence class), source details and when it was last confirmed active. Features a listing does not mention are UNKNOWN, never assumed. Reuses data fetched in the last 12 hours; otherwise makes a live request if the daily allowance permits. Source: Realtor.com (via RapidAPI) with RentCast as fallback; each result names its source. Never present results beyond what is returned.

allow_live_request.description: false = stored data only (no provider request).

avoid.description: Features that exclude a listing when the listing states them, e.g. fixer-upper, pool.

bedrooms_exception.description: e.g. 'three bedrooms, but two is fine with an office': min_bedrooms 3 plus {min_bedrooms: 2, requires: ['home office']}

ideal_max_price.description: Soft target: listings above it rank lower but stay in.

include_non_matching.description: true = also return listings that fail a hard requirement, with the reason.

max_distance.description: Straight-line distance from a place the user names (e.g. work). Not driving time.

max_price.description: Hard ceiling: listings above it are excluded.

must_have.description: Mandatory features, e.g. garage, fireplace. Unmentioned = unverified, not excluded (unless strict_unknowns).

notes.description: The user's own words, kept for reference; terms in it that match the feature list become soft preferences.

strict_unknowns.description: Exclude listings that do not state a must_have feature (default false: keep and flag).

styles.description: Architectural styles, e.g. Craftsman, Victorian, mid-century modern.
